# compliance-assistant

> Claude Code and Codex plugin that guides SOC 2, ISO 27001 and other framework work through Noru's MCP server. For Noru customers.

Who it is for: teams that already use Noru. It needs a Noru account and organization, and an authenticated connection to Noru's MCP server; it does nothing on its own. It holds no compliance data, stores no credentials and performs no sign-in. The installed plugin is a skill, MCP configuration and metadata with no executable code.

MCP endpoint (remote, Streamable HTTP, server name `noru`): `https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp`. Authenticate with OAuth where the client supports it, or with a Noru API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <NORU_API_KEY>` for manual or headless setup. Never paste tokens or keys into chat. In the official MCP Registry the server is `tech.noru/mcp`.

Install in Claude Code, then configure Noru MCP as the Claude guide below describes:

```text
/plugin marketplace add noru-tech/compliance-assistant
/plugin install compliance-assistant@compliance-assistant
```

Install in Codex:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add noru-tech/compliance-assistant
codex plugin add compliance-assistant@compliance-assistant
```

Install in GitHub Copilot CLI (it reads the same `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`), then run `/mcp auth noru`:

```bash
copilot plugin marketplace add noru-tech/compliance-assistant
copilot plugin install compliance-assistant@compliance-assistant
```

Install in Gemini CLI, then run `/mcp auth noru`:

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant
```

Cursor: the repository uses Cursor's plugin layout but is not yet listed in the Cursor Marketplace. Copy `plugins/compliance-assistant/` to `~/.cursor/plugins/local/compliance-assistant/`, then authenticate the `noru` server with OAuth or an API key.

Any other MCP client: add a remote Streamable HTTP server named `noru` at the endpoint above:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "noru": {
      "url": "https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <NORU_API_KEY>"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

A good first prompt: "Help me become compliant with SOC 2 using Noru." The assistant reads live Noru context before recommending next steps, and asks for explicit confirmation before any write-like action.

## Client guides

- [Claude Code and Claude Desktop](https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant/blob/main/clients/claude.md): plugin install, OAuth, API key, Claude Desktop bridge
- [Codex](https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant/blob/main/clients/codex.md): marketplace install, authentication, scopes
- [GitHub Copilot CLI](https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant/blob/main/clients/copilot.md): marketplace install, `/mcp auth noru`
- [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant/blob/main/clients/gemini.md): extension install, OAuth, API key in `settings.json`
- [Cursor](https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant/blob/main/clients/cursor.md): local plugin, direct HTTP or stdio bridge
- [Generic MCP clients](https://github.com/noru-tech/compliance-assistant/blob/main/clients/generic-mcp.md): direct HTTP, stdio bridge, smoke test
